title: Learning Graph Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners click each arrow in a four-concept learning graph to reveal the prerequisite relationship it encodes, then answer five questions about dependencies and valid learning order.

learningObjectives: Explain how learning graphs represent concept dependencies by identifying prerequisite relationships in a visual graph.
prerequisites: Learning Graphs and Concept Dependencies sections of Chapter 8

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration followed by identification questions
keyQuestions: Explain how learning graphs represent concept dependencies by identifying prerequisite relationships in a visual graph.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner can explain why Story Delivery and Story Analytics can be learned in either order.
